$comment: UI Moods · validate allowlist. Values here may appear as raw literals in a specimen body or app screen. Theme parameters (color, radius, shadow, font family) are NEVER allowlisted — they must resolve to var(--mood-*). See docs/css-var-mapping.md §5.

fontSize.$comment: Auxiliary text only (labels, meta, captions). Primary type sizes come from var(--mood-typography-*).

fontWeight.$comment: Weights are not injected as CSS variables; these are the values tokens.typography.weights may declare.

radius.$comment: Raw border-radius px literals are FORBIDDEN — a radius must resolve to var(--mood-radii-*). The values below are the only documented exceptions.

px.$comment: Layout rhythm only: box geometry, offsets, grid tracks, media sizes. Radii/colors/shadows/fonts are protected by separate rules.
